messages:
sophia: hey all, sophia here (day 1). Followed the onboarding but `kubectl get pods -n ml-inference` gives Forbidden. I also see two redwood contexts in my kubeconfig. who should I ping for access and a quick map of which namespace is which?

sam (infra): welcome @sophia! quick checks: run `kubectl config current-context` and `kubectl config get-contexts`. which context shows up as current?

sophia: current-context is `redwood-staging`. onboarding said to use `redwood-dev` for dev namespaces.

jen (devex): hey @sophia :wave: we maintain a short namespace map in the onboarding doc (dev vs staging vs prod). pinging @sam to provision a temp view binding. do you need port-forward?

sophia: just view + logs for now. might need port-forward when pairing later.

ops-bot: INFRA-1460 created by sam: "temp view binding for sophia in ml-inference". ETA: 10m.

sam (infra): applying a temporary RoleBinding for view in `ml-inference` to your SSO `sophia@redwood.ai`. Note: devex recommends switching to `redwood-dev` when exploring dev namespaces to avoid accidental prod reads.

lucas (ml): hi @sophia, quick namespace map: `ml-inference` = model serving (dev/staging variants), `training` = batch training infra, `feature-store` = embeddings/feature jobs. happy to do a 10-min map after you have access.

sophia: thanks everyone. ran `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n ml-inference --as sophia@redwood.ai` -> yes, and `kubectl get pods -n ml-inference` lists pods now. lucas, a short walkthrough would be great.

sam (infra): note for records: this binding is temporary (48h) and we'll add you to the `ml-developers` SSO group for permanent access once you confirm team membership.

jen (devex): added a checklist item to onboarding: "verify current-context and ask infra for temp bindings if Forbidden" and linked the namespace map doc: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/k8s-namespaces.

sophia: everything works, appreciate the quick help :tada:
